gaps.explanation: No business-type lines in detail[]; the trim (pp1-36) holds no enterprise fund schedule. Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes In Net Position (Deficit) - Proprietary Funds p9 (printed p27), columns Parking Facilities Fund / Sewer Revenue Fund / Nonmajor Enterprise Funds (Total Proprietary Funds not used; no internal service column). JSON receipts = operating revenues, charges for services + investment income (loss) + gain on sale of capital assets. Parking: 10,265,190 + gain 15,586,897 = 25,852,087. Sewer: 206,356,552 + investment income (8,128,982) = 198,227,570. Nonmajor: 7,915,435. Sum 231,995,092 = statement total. (The JSON statement lines split the Total charges for services by activity from the Statement of Activities; the fund columns print one charges-for-services row each, so one line per column is added.)

gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (Deficits) - Governmental Funds p6 (printed p23), 'Issuance of debt': only the Nonmajor Governmental Funds column prints it, 111,006,060 (General, Debt Service, Grants, Street and Highway Allocation: -). Detail already has the Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax Fund budget schedule p33 'Issuance of refunding debt' 20,866,060 (a nonmajor fund). The remaining 90,140,000 = 111,006,060 - 20,866,060 belongs to nonmajor funds (presumably capital projects funds) whose combining statements/schedules are not in the trim (pp1-36: basic statements, RSI budget schedules, statistical tables). Adding the whole nonmajor column would double count 20,866,060 and adding 90,140,000 would be a derived remainder, so no fix. Gap 90,140,000 stays.

Other printed non-zero other-financing rows of fund columns on p6 not in detail[]: General Fund 'Lease' 41,806,379 (the General Fund budgetary schedule pp12-13 prints no lease row) and Nonmajor Governmental Funds 'Proceeds on sale of capital assets' 8,618,459 (no detail line for it in any nonmajor schedule). Both added as printed. Not added: Nonmajor 'Premium on debt issued' 13,762,098 - detail already holds Riverfront 3,902,098 (p33); the other 9,860,000 is in nonmajor funds with no schedule in the trim (would be a derived remainder). Debt Service Fund premium 554,770 and Nonmajor 'Payment to escrow agent' (24,476,225) are already in detail (pp32-33). No mislabelled transfer lines in detail.
